arms.DIRECT: protocol-aligned direct success: logit a_q (+ xs(g_q, v_s, c)) trained by root-summed BCE on x AND y of every decided X query, no-op logit b_0 trained on Y0; same modules and parameter count as XY-quadratic; lambda_J = 0, gamma = 0

LB (historical reference).protocol: trained on BD_GEN_V1 whole-sequence outcomes from the ACHIEVED robot state (different execution-outcome protocol); evaluated on val21 from its frozen predictions and later on the fresh cohort; not cross-fittable; gamma = 0

arms.XY-quadratic: primary: F2 a_q, F3 b_s, F5 w_q = xy(g_q, v_s, c); lambda_J = its own validation-selected lambda* in LAMBDAS
arms.XY-quadratic-noJ: same model, lambda_J = 0; selection gamma = 0 (its travel head is untrained)
arms.XY-uncoupled: same shared representation, w = 0; lambda* selected by the same rule
arms.XY-uncoupled-SA: capacity / feature control: w = 0 and a_q += xs(g_q, v_s, c), a head with the SAME inputs and parameter count as the coupling head; isolates the x*y interaction from extra scene features and capacity

references.DISPLACEMENT_RANK: smallest C_d F1-admissible nonempty candidate (m, signature ties)
references.ORACLE_AVAILABILITY: any admissible successful candidate in the root's catalogue
references.SHORTEST_ADMISSIBLE: shortest F1-admissible nonempty candidate (C_d, signature ties)
references.VERIFY_FIRST (oracle): evaluator verifies admissible candidates in (m, C_d, signature) order; reports success and verifications

budget.checkpoint: after 12 finished runs: projected = spent / expected(finished) x expected(all); stop launching (never kill a running run) if projected > aggregate cap
budget.memory_gate: launch a worker only if available memory >= 2.0 GB + 0.8 GB per running worker (ramp 2 -> 4 -> 8); the host showed ~4 GB available at P11, so the wall request assumes 4 effective workers

custody.excluded: 34 historical test roots (exposed in P7): historical diagnostics only, never trained, tuned, early-stopped or evaluated in P12
custody.rule: bxy_data.split_of (family-grouped IID); build() raises on any test root

evaluation.confirmatory: SPLIT checkpoints (3 seeds per arm, frozen before the cohort exists) on the fresh independent cohort, evaluated once

coupling_decision.BENEFICIAL: Delta logloss (quadratic - control) CI upper < 0 vs BOTH controls, selection non-inferior (CI lower > -0.05) vs both, >= 2 of 3 seeds individually improve vs both
coupling_decision.UNSUPPORTED: point estimate Delta logloss >= 0 vs either control, or selection point estimate < 0 with CI lower <= -0.05
coupling_decision.deployment: if not BENEFICIAL on the fresh cohort, the learned coupling is removed from the deployed model (methodology §8.2)
coupling_decision.development_label: a CROSSFIT verdict is development evidence only; the confirmatory verdict is the fresh-cohort one

evaluation.development_primary: CROSSFIT out-of-fold predictions of all 197 train+val roots (each root scored by models that never trained on it); per-root metrics averaged over the 3 seeds, then paired root-cluster bootstrap (B = 10000) between arms
evaluation.development_split: SPLIT models on val21 (descriptive only; LB comparable only here)
evaluation.direct_decision: the factorized model is preferred over DIRECT only if it is not worse on success logloss (CI upper < 0.02) and selection (CI lower > -0.05); otherwise DIRECT / LB is reported as the simpler alternative
evaluation.omission: sign agreement of predicted changes (P(X), P(Y), p_succ) with decided full -> omitted transitions; two-move interaction table descriptive; no geometrically-necessary-cause claim from planner-budget zeros (only the certified subset may support one)
evaluation.ordering: concordance of p_succ (and P(X)) on discordant same-endpoint order pairs, separately for the certified (sound relocation certificate) and budget/planner-policy failing orders; never pooled into a single causal claim

probability.metrics: root-averaged log loss and Brier (each root weight 1), pooled log loss / Brier, ECE10, reliability diagrams
sets: X: P(X=1) marginal vs every observed X
Y: P(Y=1) vs every observed Y
success: p_succ vs x AND y of every decided X query + P(Y0) vs Y0
joint observed-data NLL per root (XY arms)

selection: success on initially infeasible roots (Y0 = 0) [PRIMARY decision metric]
travel regret vs the root's minimum successful J
evaluation.strata: K0 / K1 / K>=2 / unknown-K reported separately with the actual number of independent roots; no claim when a stratum has < 10 roots
evaluation.travel_decision: lambda* retained over 0 only if XY-quadratic vs XY-quadratic-noJ: Delta success logloss CI upper < 0.02 (calibration not sacrificed) and paired witnessed J of successful choices lower with CI upper < 0
evaluation.uncertainty: root-cluster bootstrap; per-seed results also reported; queries are never treated as independent samples
visualizations: reliability diagrams of P(X), P(Y), p_succ per arm
per-root paired difference plots with bootstrap CIs
loss curves (train total / NLL / travel, early-stopping NLL) per run
order-contrast panels (certified vs budget) with scenes
no-op decisions (P(Y0) vs Y0 per root)
selection error gallery: false repairs and missed repairs with scenes
failure categories of chosen candidates (relocation / connector / target, certified vs budget)
successful selected corrections with replayed witnesses
w distribution by four-cell outcome (descriptive only)

feature_access.LB: same scene inputs, LB candidate encoding
feature_access.all learned arms: scene inputs + ordered actions + edited endpoint scenes (identical); no label, role, travel or failure field
feature_access.selection: p, m, C_d (exact), J_hat (J-trained arms only), F1 admissibility

fresh_cohort_protocol.catalogue: outcome-blind proposer: candidates enumerated from geometry only (all sufficient blocker subsets of the analytic swept-volume obstruction set up to 4 moves, both orders for 2-move sets, one alternative destination, one redundant and one wrong-destination control, a fixed number per root by a seeded rule); no teacher outcome of a candidate decides whether it enters the catalogue; the catalogue is frozen and hashed before any teacher query
fresh_cohort_protocol.custody: generated, labelled and hashed by a runner that cannot import model code; frozen before any model is evaluated; evaluated once
fresh_cohort_protocol.generator: a new versioned BD_GEN generator seed space disjoint from BD_GEN_V1 families (new family ids, new seeds, hash-checked disjointness)
fresh_cohort_protocol.historical_test: the 34 exposed BD_GEN_V1 test roots remain historical diagnostics only
fresh_cohort_protocol.labels: the frozen BXY teacher (same teacher hash, budgets, q_ref, F1) queries X, Y, Y0 for every admissible catalogue candidate plus reversals and omissions; independent replay of every positive
fresh_cohort_protocol.purpose: the confirmatory, never-seen evaluation of the frozen SPLIT checkpoints
fresh_cohort_protocol.size: planning target >= 300 independent roots with >= 200 initially infeasible (about 4x the 55 available now); the exact size is set by a paired-root power calculation that uses the CROSSFIT discordance rate, inside the cohort's own budget request

interface.admissibility: bxy_f1.screen complete_ok (x_ok, y_ok, no GOAL_BLOCKED); the zero-move candidate is always admissible
interface.candidate_order: sorted by (m, action signature); the historical catalogue order (minimal success first) is never used
interface.evaluator: EvalView: candidate outcomes, teacher status / negative kind / failed phase / certificate, legacy roles, order groups, omissions
interface.labels: Labels object: observed X / Y (absent = marginalized), DIRECT success events, complete-witness travel
interface.scene_inputs: abc_models.Root of RECORDS.pt `inputs` only: object_xy, object_radius, is_active_target, is_obstacle (= object kind), robot_q, goal_xy, robot_fk_joints, DINOv2 visual features of the rendered scene
interface.variables: every F1-admissible PMIN_DEV_MATCHED design query of the root (outcome-free design) + parent Y of every X + Y0

limitations: val21 is small (10 initially infeasible roots): SPLIT validation results are descriptive; development comparisons use 197-root cross-fitting and confirmation needs the fresh cohort
K0 dominates (142 / 197 roots); K>=2 has 9 roots and unknown-K 9; K3 / K4 are essentially absent -> no stratum claim with < 10 roots
most negatives are budget-limited (X 328 of 490, Y 281 of 345): zeros are budget-policy-relative, not impossibility; certified subsets are small (X 162, Y 64; 24 certified order failures)

the historical catalogue is outcome-guided (BD_GEN_V1 'minimal' = first teacher-verified success, other roles derived from it): scorers never see roles or catalogue order, but catalogue composition inflates oracle availability (48 / 55 infeasible roots) for every method alike
every P-min variable is observed: exact marginalization is tested but inactive on this data (it matters for PREFIX_COMPLETE and future cohorts)
conditional independence of X queries given their shared Y is a modelling approximation
lambda* selection uses val21; val roots later appear as cross-fit held-out roots (low-dimensional choice; disclosed)
LB is trained on a different execution-outcome protocol and cannot be cross-fitted; its comparison is val21 + fresh cohort only
travel labels are first-witness teacher-policy travel, not minimum travel

objective.J_hat: complete travel: jt(v_s, c) + softplus(cost(g_q)) for a nonempty prefix (relocations + connector + target), jt(v_0, c) for the no-op
objective.L_joint: mean over batch roots of -log P(D_c), exact per-unique-scene marginalization (bxy_p11.log_evidence == bxy_core.log_evidence == brute force)
objective.L_travel: sum over the batch's complete witnesses of Huber_delta=1(log1p J_hat, log1p J) / N_J (methodology §6.2 pooled form)
objective.p_success: sigmoid(b_s) sigmoid(a_q+w_q); no-op: P(Y0=1) (X_empty = 1 by definition, no X variable)

selection.cost: C(r) = -log p_succ(r) + alpha m(r) + beta C_d(r) + gamma J_hat(r), C_d in lattice cells (L = 0.08 m)
selection.not_tuned: fixed a priori: val21 has 10 initially infeasible roots, too few to tune 4 decision hyperparameters
selection.selection_vs_training_weights: alpha, beta, gamma, eta are decision hyperparameters; lambda_J is the training auxiliary weight

stop: P11 performs no training, tuning, teacher query, scene generation, test evaluation, PREFIX_COMPLETE, P-full or 3D work

changes_from_historical: data: verified P-min V2 sidecar via leakage-separated views (was V1 / LB records)
travel loss pooled over witnesses per methodology §6.2 (was per-root mean)
J_hat includes target travel and the no-op target travel (was 0 for the no-op)
early stopping on NLL only, never on selection
training.early_stopping_metric: mean root NLL of the arm's own likelihood (joint NLL for XY, success BCE for DIRECT) on the early-stopping roots; restore the best checkpoint
training.lambda_selection: per J-trained arm: lambda* = argmin over LAMBDAS of the mean over 3 seeds of the best val21 joint NLL; a relative difference <= 1e-3 is a tie -> smaller lambda
training.sampling: uniform root sampling without replacement per update (root-balanced)
